description: This file defines the StaticModule class which wraps around torch's internal static module representation, providing methods for initialization, invocation, benchmarking, asynchronous running, and benchmarking individual operations.

classes.name: StaticModule
classes.description: A wrapper class around torch's internal static module representation, enabling static module operations such as invocation and benchmarking.

methods.name: __init__(self, scripted)
methods.description: Initializes StaticModule by converting a scripted module or its graph into a static module using torch._C._jit_to_static_module.

methods.name: __call__(self, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Allows the StaticModule instance to be called like a function, forwarding arguments to the internal static module.

methods.name: benchmark(self, args, kwargs, warmup_runs, main_runs)
methods.description: Runs a benchmark on the static module with specified warmup and main runs.

methods.name: runAsync(self, args, kwargs)
methods.description: Executes the static module asynchronously with provided arguments.

methods.name: benchmark_individual_ops(self, args, kwargs, warmup_runs, main_runs)
methods.description: Benchmarks individual operations within the static module.

ctags.name: benchmark
ctags.pattern: /^    def benchmark(self, args, kwargs, warmup_runs, main_runs):$/

ctags.name: benchmark_individual_ops
ctags.pattern: /^    def benchmark_individual_ops(self, args, kwargs, warmup_runs, main_runs):$/
